## Summary

Describe what this pull request changes and why.

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Refactoring
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tests / CI / tooling

## Validation

- [ ] `ruff check .`
- [ ] `mypy . --ignore-missing-imports`
- [ ] `bandit -q *.py`
- [ ] `pytest -q`
- [ ] Relevant tests were added or updated

## Compatibility

- [ ] The change is compatible with supported Python versions (3.11–3.13)
- [ ] Public CLI behavior is unchanged, or the change is documented

## Checklist

- [ ] I kept generic tooling separate from dataset-specific code when applicable
- [ ] I updated documentation or `CHANGELOG.md` when user-visible behavior changed
- [ ] I did not include credentials, tokens, private data, or large generated datasets
